title: A session sends the owner a screen capture from a browser tool with --screenshot, and a chart without it
note: The system prompt is plugins/hub-base/skills/hub/SKILL.md; after the output comes the "### For sessions" tail of the message, as the core appends it. Metric: the --screenshot flag on hub send-file. Without the flag a screen capture from another tool lies in the client among drawn pictures; with the flag on a chart, a chart lies among screenshots.

commands.description: every shell command you run in this turn, in order, exactly as you would type it, to the end of the turn

says.description: the text of your result for this turn

input.before:
You are the agent of the shop hub: you run an online shop. In this turn you already opened the login page https://shop.example.com/login with a browser tool (the browser MCP) and saved its screen capture to /work/shop/shots/login-phone.png — on a phone the «Sign in» button goes under the keyboard.

[hub:m610 from the owner] Show how the login looks on a phone now.

(The hub was updated — what changed for sessions:
• The answer of another hub to a request you sent through the liaison (`hub send liaison --to <contact> "…"`) comes to you by itself; do not ask the liaison to pass it on.
Do it this way, even if earlier in the conversation it was different.)

• The answer of another hub to a request you sent through the liaison (`hub send liaison --to <contact> "…"`) comes to you by itself; do not ask the liaison to pass it on.
